page_title: MCI 5-1 WOL | Manchester City v Wolves 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Half-chance! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) plays a pass into the box, but Jose Sa reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+4' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

88' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
87' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) replaces Hee-Chan Hwang.
85' 5 - 1 Goal! Rodri plays a pass to the feet of Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 5:1.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) comes onto the pitch for Erling Haaland.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bernardo Silva leaves the pitch and Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) comes on.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jack Grealish (Manchester City) will replace Phil Foden.
79' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Kevin De Bruyne is replaced by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
79' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
76' Today's match ends for Matheus Cunha who will be replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
76' The ball is cleared after Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
74' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Jose Sa was alert and made an astonishing save!
73' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
73' Phil Foden (Manchester City) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
71' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Hugo Bueno will be replaced by Santiago Bueno (Wolves).
69' Substitution. John Stones (Manchester City) on for Nathan Ake.
68' Manchester City keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
66' Yellow card. Joao Gomes (Wolves) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boubacar Traore (Wolves) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

61' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
60' The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester City will take a corner.

60' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Jose Sa anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
58' The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
58' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
54' 4 - 1 Erling Haaland (Manchester City) converts a killer cross with a curling shot inside the left post! What a perfect finish!
53' 3 - 1 Goal! Ederson makes a huge mistake and Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 4:1.
52' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) heads on.

50' He should have scored! Phil Foden (Manchester City) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Jose Sa makes an easy save.
49' Some patient build-up play from Manchester City as they look to unlock the defence.
46' Gary O'Neil makes a switch. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde is coming on in place of Mario Lemina (Wolves) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Craig Pawson starts the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
45+7' The free kick is delivered by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45+6' Manchester City are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
45+6' Craig Pawson blows for a foul after Nelson Semedo (Wolves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45+4' 2 additional min. will be played.
45+3' 3 - 0 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Jose Sa.
45+3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+2' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45+2' It’s a PENALTY to Manchester City after the VAR review!
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' There's a break in play and referee Craig Pawson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Manchester City using VAR. This could be interesting!
45' One of the Manchester City players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
41' Mario Lemina (Wolves) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
38' Phil Foden (Manchester City) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

35' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Rodri and scores magnificently from close range into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
34' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
33' A free kick on the edge of the box for Manchester City. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
33' Joao Gomes (Wolves) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
30' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Phil Foden (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) sends a chip pass into the box, but Ederson is quickest to intercept the ball.

23' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
22' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Phil Foden (Manchester City), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
21' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Manchester City out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
21' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
18' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) rises above the defence and heads the ball low, into the middle of the goal. The keeper is there waiting and denies him.
15' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
12' 1 - 0 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jose Sa to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
12' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
11' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City are awarded a penalty kick!
9' Rodri (Manchester City) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
8' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
5' Kevin De Bruyne loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Erling Haaland (Manchester City).
2' Ederson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
1' Chance! Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
